behavioral_baseline_modeling_enabled.title: Behavioral Baseline Modeling Enabled
behavioral_baseline_modeling_enabled.description: Indicates whether the system is actively building and maintaining statistical baseline models for user, process, and network behaviors.

false_positive_rate_percent.title: False Positive Rate (Percent)
false_positive_rate_percent.description: The measured false positive rate as a percentage of total alerts generated by the behavioral anomaly detection system over the past 30 days.

monitored_entity_scopes.title: Monitored Entity Scopes
monitored_entity_scopes.description: The categories of entities actively monitored for behavioral anomalies (e.g., user_accounts, service_accounts, endpoints, network_flows, cloud_identities).

sensor_deployment_percentage.title: Endpoint Sensor Deployment Percentage
sensor_deployment_percentage.description: Percentage of managed endpoints with an active EDR/telemetry sensor currently enrolled and reporting.

telemetry_collection_channels.title: Active Telemetry Collection Channels
telemetry_collection_channels.description: List of active telemetry data collection channels enabled on enrolled endpoints (e.g., process, file, registry, memory, network).

sensor_health_status.title: Sensor Health Status
sensor_health_status.description: Overall health status of the endpoint sensor fleet as reported by the EDR management platform.

automated_response_enabled.title: Automated Response Enabled
automated_response_enabled.description: Whether policy-driven automated response actions (isolation, process termination, network quarantine) are globally enabled in the threat detection and response system.

response_action_types_configured.title: Configured Response Action Types
response_action_types_configured.description: List of automated response action types currently configured and active in policy (e.g., 'network_quarantine', 'process_termination', 'host_isolation', 'account_disable').

response_trigger_mode.title: Response Trigger Mode
response_trigger_mode.description: Defines under what confirmation level automated containment actions are triggered without analyst intervention.

threat_feed_integration_enabled.title: Threat Feed Integration Enabled
threat_feed_integration_enabled.description: Whether external and/or internal threat intelligence feeds are actively integrated with the alerting and detection system for real-time IOC enrichment.

ioc_matching_scope.title: IOC Matching Scope
ioc_matching_scope.description: The breadth of indicator types actively matched against telemetry (IPs, domains, hashes, URLs, email addresses, etc.).

reputation_scoring_active.title: Contextual Reputation Scoring Active
reputation_scoring_active.description: Whether alerts are automatically enriched with reputation scores from threat intelligence sources at detection or triage time.

log_source_types_ingested.title: Log Source Types Ingested
log_source_types_ingested.description: List of distinct log source categories actively ingested into the SIEM/correlation platform (e.g., endpoint, network, cloud, identity).

log_normalization_enabled.title: Log Normalization Enabled
log_normalization_enabled.description: Whether ingested logs from disparate sources are normalized to a common schema (e.g., ECS, OCSF, CEF) enabling unified timeline analysis.

cross_source_correlation_rules_count.title: Active Cross-Source Correlation Rules Count
cross_source_correlation_rules_count.description: Number of active detection rules or analytics that reference more than one log source type in a single detection logic chain.

ml_alert_scoring_enabled.title: ML Alert Scoring Enabled
ml_alert_scoring_enabled.description: Indicates whether machine learning-driven alert scoring is active and configured to assign confidence scores to incoming alerts.

alert_deduplication_enabled.title: Alert Deduplication Enabled
alert_deduplication_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated alert deduplication or correlation is active, grouping related alerts into unified cases or incidents.

case_enrichment_integrations.title: Case Enrichment Integrations
case_enrichment_integrations.description: List of active enrichment integrations (e.g., threat intel, asset context, vulnerability data) feeding automated context into cases during triage.

false_positive_auto_closure_enabled.title: False Positive Auto-Closure Enabled
false_positive_auto_closure_enabled.description: Indicates whether the system is configured to automatically close or suppress alerts classified as false positives based on ML scoring or rule-based logic.

evidence_collection_enabled.title: Evidence Collection Enabled
evidence_collection_enabled.description: Indicates whether the forensic evidence collection pipeline is active, including process execution trees, memory snapshots, network packet captures, and file change history.

tamper_evident_logging_mode.title: Tamper-Evident Logging Mode
tamper_evident_logging_mode.description: The mode of tamper protection applied to forensic logs, ensuring integrity for legal hold and incident reconstruction.

retention_days.title: Forensic Data Retention Period (Days)
retention_days.description: The number of days forensic evidence is retained to meet incident reconstruction and legal hold requirements. Also used as the unified log timeline retention indicator.

covered_evidence_types.title: Covered Evidence Types
covered_evidence_types.description: List of forensic evidence categories actively being captured. Expected values include process_execution_tree, memory_snapshot, network_packet_capture, file_change_history.

rule_versioning_enabled.title: Detection Rule Versioning Enabled
rule_versioning_enabled.description: Indicates whether the detection platform maintains version history for detection rules, allowing rollback and change tracking.

feedback_loop_mechanism.title: Incident Feedback Loop Mechanism
feedback_loop_mechanism.description: The method by which closed incident outcomes are fed back into detection rule tuning to reduce false positives and rule decay.

rule_review_frequency_days.title: Rule Review Frequency (Days)
rule_review_frequency_days.description: Maximum number of days between scheduled reviews of detection rule effectiveness and currency.

cloud_workload_agent_deployed.title: Cloud Workload Agent Deployed
cloud_workload_agent_deployed.description: Indicates whether a security agent or sensor capable of collecting telemetry from cloud-native workloads, containers, and serverless functions is deployed and active across the cloud environment.

container_runtime_monitoring_enabled.title: Container Runtime Monitoring Enabled
container_runtime_monitoring_enabled.description: Indicates whether runtime security monitoring (syscall-level or eBPF-based) is enabled for container workloads to detect anomalous process execution, network activity, or file system changes at runtime.

detection_coverage_scope.title: Detection Coverage Scope
detection_coverage_scope.description: Describes the breadth of workload types covered by telemetry and detection rules within the security platform.

bidirectional_api_integrations_enabled.title: Bidirectional API Integrations Enabled
bidirectional_api_integrations_enabled.description: Indicates whether bidirectional API integrations are configured and active between the platform and external security tools (SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity platforms).

integrated_platform_types.title: Integrated Platform Types
integrated_platform_types.description: List of external platform categories actively integrated via API (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity).

automated_playbook_or_ticket_workflow_ac.title: Automated Playbook or Ticket Workflow Active
automated_playbook_or_ticket_workflow_ac.description: Indicates whether at least one automated response playbook, ticket creation workflow, or enrichment workflow is active and triggered via the API integrations.
